title: AICP Card
description: A platform-issued identity document representing a single agent or agent group in the Agent Identity Card Protocol.

operator_id.description: Reference to the authenticated operator account

name.description: Human-readable name for the agent. Must be unique per operator.

description.description: Free-text description of the agent's capabilities

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the Card

mcp_endpoint_url.description: The platform's MCP endpoint scoped to this Card

agent_count.description: Number of agents or workers behind this Card

last_health_check.description: Timestamp of the last platform-initiated health probe

capabilities.description: List of work class IDs this Card is qualified for

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for platform-specific extensions

attestations.description: Attestation data for this Card (federation profile). Contains native attestation and any imported attestations from federated platforms.

native.description: This platform's own attestation for this Card (JWT compact serialization)

issuer.description: The platform that issued this attestation

verified_at.description: When this platform verified the attestation signature

accepted_claims.description: Claims accepted after applying the attribute_filter from the trust config

imported.description: Attestations imported from federated platforms, with verification metadata
